description: Monthly Modal Time Series is a dataset listed in data.transportation.gov (U.S. DOT open data portal), an open data portal of the U.S. Department of Transportation under the section "Public Transit", published or maintained by U.S. Department of Transportation. Modal Service data and Safety & Security (S&S) public transit time series data delineated by transit/agency/mode/year/month. Includes all Full Reporters--transit agencies operating modes with more than 30 vehicles in maximum service--to the National Transit Database (NTD). This dataset will be updated monthly. Coverage: United States (see the dataset for state or local subsets). The portal files it under "Public Transit". It has 77 columns, among them Suicide Injuries, Non-Major Physical Assaults on Operators, Non-Major Physical Assaults on Other Transit Workers, Non-Major Non-Physical Assaults on Other Transit Workers, Major Physical Assaults on Operators, Total Assaults on Transit Workers. The portal shows 2026-09-04 as the last data update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is public domain (as labelled on the portal). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, safety and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-usdot-data-transportation-gov-portal.
